entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So this is White Day, huh?[n]There's certainly a lot of people here.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Indeed. It's impressive that this many[n]people would show up.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, it's good to have a lot of friends,[n]right? I don't like to get too involved[n]with that kind of stuff.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This is one of [fName]'s charms so...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Heh, it seems that I was right about you.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It seems that you don't really understand[n]girls, but... Heh. I guess I knew that.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: He said he didn't have any friends.[n]Could it be thanks to me?[n]...Just kidding.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'm an adult and I understand you have[n]your reasons, so I won't say anything.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I'm just happy to drink the coffee[n]you make...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: So this is White Day. Are you happy,[n]senpai?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: You seem uncertain. Are you having[n]trouble actually feeling happy? Oh, or...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Are you so happy that it seems unreal?[n]Oh, or could it be...
...I served everyone coffee[n]and the White Day was over.
